title: CGPSC ADPPO Exam City / Exam Schedule 2026
vacancyDetails: Exam city and schedule released for CGPSC ADPPO examination 2026
qualification: Law degree (LL.B.) or as per CGPSC ADPPO notification
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Interview / further stages → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Registration number; later admit card printout and photo ID for exam
howToApply:
1. Visit https://psc.cg.gov.in
2. Open ADPPO Exam City / Schedule notice
3. Check allotted exam city and date
4. Download admit card when activated
5. Reach centre as per schedule with photo ID
shortDescription: CGPSC ADPPO Exam City / Exam Schedule 2026 released. Check details at psc.cg.gov.in.
content:
Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) has released the Exam City / Exam Schedule 2026 for the Assistant District Public Prosecution Officer (ADPPO) examination.

Candidates can check their allotted exam city and tentative schedule on the official CGPSC portal. Hall tickets will be available as per the timeline mentioned in the notice.

Next steps

  • Note exam city carefully
  • Download admit card when link is live
  • Carry admit card + original photo ID on exam day
